headline: Cruise control —
32 clear and coasting
body: Wirtz did bits for 13, Groß chipped in 10, and Umar matching his 51 changed precisely nothing up top.
Then he spent his one waiver on a crocked Mitoma and parked him on the bench. That's not a transfer, that's a flex. 32 clear and shopping for fun.

headline: Wrong keeper again —
it's a whole saga now
body: Kinsky got the nod and returned 2. Verbruggen rode the pine for 6. Third week on the spin. Verbruggen's agent should be on the phone.
Le Fée was cooking with 11 and the side banked 51, a proper week. Imad also banked 51. Gap: 32. Running hard, going nowhere.

headline: Gonzalo or Awoniyi —
both blanked, who cares
body: Two weeks sweating the Gonzalo or Awoniyi call and fumbling it both times. This week they both blanked on 2, so for once Rihab couldn't get it wrong.
Vuskovic hauled 12 and kept the lights on. Third place, 34 off Umar and 18 clear of Vidhun. Sitting pretty in no man's land.

headline: 113 in a fortnight —
then the wheels came off
body: Best two-week run in the league, then a 35, second-worst of the week. Thiago somehow went minus with -2. You have to work for that.
N. Jackson's 11 stopped it becoming a full pile-up. Fourth is hanging by one point, with Split the G FC on his neck.

headline: Barry 16 —
one point off fourth
body: Barry was on a different planet: a brace against Coventry, an assist and max bonus for 16. Biggest haul of the week.
Meanwhile Flemming has been binned and re-signed by the same manager inside a fortnight. His welcome-back gift: a bench seat and a 0. Make your mind up.

headline: Top score of the week —
with three no-shows
body: Three starters didn't kick a ball and Munir still topped the week. The bench rolled in with 12, McGinn bagged 10, Cherki 9: 59 all in.
He binned Bruno Fernandes for McGinn, Bruno dropped 10 for Sandaru, McGinn matched it. Honours even. Green arrow to sixth, and he'll swear it was the plan all along.

headline: Drops 49 —
red arrow anyway
body: Delap bagged a brace against City for 13 and Ødegaard pulled the strings for 11. Proper week. Then Munir dropped 59 and leapfrogged him anyway.
Every other manager has hit the waiver wire in the last two windows. Dulaj hasn't so much as looked. Either he's backing his squad to the hilt or he's never found the button.

headline: Defence: 29 —
attack: 1
body: Roefs 9, Konsa 8, Castagne 7: the back line ate. Up top, Igor Jesus and Solanke scraped 1 between them. Famine.
His fix? Two more defenders off the wire. Galaxy brain stuff.

headline: Already ran the 10k —
now the big one's lurking
body: Bottom of the week on 34, with Trafford on the bench for 10 while Lammens started for 1. Nine points binned.
He's already paid one forfeit in sweat, the 10k. Now Sandaru's 7 back and closing, and the end-of-season forfeit for 10th is lurking. His calves are nervous.

headline: An hour staring at a wall —
two gameweeks to dodge it
body: Next mini forfeit: one hour, one wall, zero entertainment. As it stands, Sandaru's the one booked in. Two gameweeks to wriggle out.
Bruno Fernandes was a savvy pickup: 10 on debut, and the gap to ninth chopped from 14 to 7. The wall is still the bookies' favourite, though.
